name: @castellan/rust-xtask
description: Turbo package for the castellan-xtask Cargo crate: per-crate nextest and clippy so `turbo run test/lint --affected` can select the changed crates and their dependents. Workspace-wide Cargo invocations stay on @castellan/rust.

scripts.lint: pixi run cargo clippy -p castellan-xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pixi run cargo nextest run -p castellan-xtask
